desc:
⭐NEW CODE AT 100 LIKES⭐

🚨 SMASH COPS is a wild police chase game! Floor it, crash through the city and outrun the sirens for as long as you can. How long can you survive?

🤖 NEW: DASH, the transforming rally robot, a gift on day 7 of the daily rewards!

🚓 20 heat levels: police cars, SWAT, tanks, helicopters, coast guard, aliens and even angry gods
💥 Wreck the city: buildings crumble and gas stations explode
🚗 38 cars to collect, each with 3 crazy skills
⬆️ Upgrade every car to LVL 3 for a wilder look and stronger skills
🎰 Spin the Prize Vault for new cars with epic reveal cutscenes
🦾 Unlock OMEGA, the supercar that turns into a giant robot
📅 Daily rewards, missions and achievements
📱 Play on PC, phone and tablet

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for more cars and updates!

🏷️ Tags: police chase, car game, driving, escape, cops and robbers, destruction, car crash, robot car, transforming car, simulator, racing, smashy road, RNG
